title: OpenAI documentation versus the ACP specification
caption: Five points where OpenAI's implementation docs differ from the 2026-04-17 spec. The spec is primary for ACP; OpenAI's docs are primary for what ChatGPT expects. Accept both forms where you can.
alt: Side-by-side list. Spec: feed paths /feeds; webhooks order_create and order_update; complete returns 200; idempotency_conflict is 422; TLS 1.3 required. OpenAI docs: feed paths /product_feeds plus a promotions API; webhooks order_created and order_updated; complete returns 201 Created; idempotency_conflict is 409; TLS 1.2 or later. Each pair is marked as differing.

sourceOfTruth.label: OpenAI Agentic Commerce docs and the ACP 2026-04-17 spec
